scripted_viewpoints.name: Reentry shock layer
scripted_viewpoints.description: Peak-heating shock layer on a vehicle in a real atmosphere, entering belly-first: freestream driven by FlowDebugOverride so the state is reproducible without flying an entry. Scrub with THALOS_REENTRY_DENSITY / THALOS_REENTRY_SPEED.

scripted_viewpoints.name: Transonic vapour cone
scripted_viewpoints.description: The sunlit condensation collar around a cruising airframe near Mach 1. Humidity, density, speed and nose-side arrival direction are driven by FlowDebugOverride because all three gates must open at once; atmospheric presence remains real. Scrub with THALOS_VAPOR_MACH / THALOS_VAPOR_HUMIDITY / THALOS_VAPOR_Q.

scripted_viewpoints.name: Interstage shroud
scripted_viewpoints.description: Two-stage Saturn on the pad, framed across the interstage: the regression probe for the flight-craft decoupler shroud.

scripted_viewpoints.name: Orbital stainless hull
scripted_viewpoints.description: Close on a stainless craft in low orbit with the planet behind it: the only framing that judges what a mirror hull REFLECTS in space. Every other orbital view frames the planet, so a hull reflecting a flat disc instead of continents is invisible in all of them.
